title: Senior Administrator, Financial Systems & Automation (NetSuite)
description:
**Our Mission**
 You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
   

  

 We’re here to give power to the patient.
   

  

 For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace \- helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
   

  

 Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
 *seeking* 
 to
 *getting* 
 . We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
   

  

 Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
   

  

**Your Impact on our mission**
 Healthcare is too hard. At Zocdoc, we work every day to make it easier for patients to get the care they need.
   

  

 As Senior Administrator, Financial Systems \& Automation, you’ll help ensure that the systems supporting Zocdoc’s financial operations are reliable, secure, scalable, and easy to use. You’ll own the Finance Applications service experience from intake through resolution, serve as a hands\-on NetSuite expert, and help improve the connected tools and processes that Finance and Accounting rely on every day.
   

  

 This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving practical systems problems, improving how work gets done, and taking ownership from the first request through the final outcome.
   

  

**You’ll enjoy this role if you are**
* Energised by owning a system, service queue, or project from beginning to end
* Comfortable making thoughtful decisions when requirements are incomplete or priorities change
* Motivated by turning ambiguous problems into clear next steps
* Someone stakeholders trust for NetSuite guidance, issue resolution, and process improvement
* Structured and consistent in your approach to SLAs, documentation, testing, and follow\-through
* Curious about automation and responsible uses of AI
* Comfortable balancing speed, user experience, data integrity, security, and financial controls


**Your day\-to\-day is**
**Own Finance Applications service delivery**
* Manage the Finance Applications Jira queue from intake and triage through prioritization, communication, escalation, resolution, validation, and closure
* Track backlog, aging, blocked work, SLA risk, reopen rates, and recurring issues, taking action before commitments are missed
* Clarify incomplete requests, set realistic expectations, provide proactive updates, and close the loop with requesters
* Improve Jira Service Management workflows, dashboards, reporting, intake quality, knowledge articles, and escalation practices


**Administer and improve NetSuite**
* Configure and support NetSuite workflows, approvals, roles and permissions, saved searches, reports, forms, and related functionality
* Translate Finance and Accounting requirements into practical solutions that improve accuracy, control, scalability, and user experience
* Investigate transaction, reporting, access, workflow, and integration issues and determine the appropriate resolution path
* Coordinate sandbox validation, regression testing, release readiness, production deployment, and post\-change verification
* Maintain documentation for configurations, dependencies, operating procedures, and support guidance


**Lead projects and continuous improvement**
* Manage financial\-systems projects from discovery and requirements through planning, testing, implementation, rollout, and follow\-up
* Define outcomes, scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, owners, decisions, and next steps
* Coordinate contributors across Finance, Accounting, FP\&A, IT, Engineering, and external vendors
* Identify blockers early, recommend practical paths forward, and escalate with context and a proposed decision
* Deliver measurable improvements in reliability, efficiency, data quality, user experience, or control effectiveness


**Strengthen automation, controls, and documentation**
* Identify repetitive, manual, or error\-prone processes that can be improved through configuration, automation, controls, or clearer documentation
* Investigate data mismatches, integration failures, and process breaks using reports, logs, testing, and root\-cause analysis
* Build or improve dashboards and operational reporting for service delivery, system health, project progress, and process performance
* Follow change\-management, access\-management, segregation\-of\-duties, and audit\-readiness practices
* Maintain runbooks, knowledge articles, process documentation, testing evidence, and handoff materials


**You’ll be successful in this role if you have**
* 5\+years of experience in financial systems, ERP administration, finance operations technology, or a related field
* Strong hands\-on NetSuite administration and configuration experience, including workflows, approvals, roles and permissions, saved searches, reporting, forms, and troubleshooting
* Experience owning a service queue, ticketing process, or internal systems\-support function against defined SLAs
* Experience with Jira or Jira Service Management, including queues, workflows, dashboards, reporting, intake, escalation, or automation
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage projects, coordinate stakeholders, and deliver results with limited day\-to\-day supervision
* Strong analytical and root\-cause problem\-solving skills across systems, data, and business processes
* Experience managing external vendor support cases with clear documentation, urgency, and follow\-through
* Experience with system testing, release management, change control, production validation, and operational documentation
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues and decisions to non\-technical stakeholders
* A track record of ownership, sound judgment, proactive risk escalation, and strong internal customer service
* A bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* NetSuite Administrator certification
* Experience with connected finance platforms such as Coupa, Planful, ADP, Salesforce, or banking systems
* Experience translating business needs into requirements, action plans, decisions, and validation plans
* Experience influencing without authority across Finance, Accounting, IT, Engineering, vendors, and distributed teams
* Experience using automation or AI tools to improve finance operations, documentation, reporting, or user support


**What Success Looks Like**
* Finance Applications requests are visible, actively managed, and resolved against agreed service commitments
* Requesters receive timely communication, clear expectations, and complete resolution documentation
* NetSuite configurations and workflows are reliable, well governed, well documented, and aligned to business needs
* Financial\-systems projects move forward with clear ownership, decisions, milestones, and measurable outcomes
* Recurring issues and manual work decrease through root\-cause fixes, automation, and process improvements
* Stakeholders trust you to make progress, navigate ambiguity, and escalate risks early


**Benefits**
* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Flexible, hybrid work environment
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare reimbursement
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check\-ups
* Sponsored counselling and therapy via Betterlyf
* Competitive PTO
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2022\-2026


**About Us**
 Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in\-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in\-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last\-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.
   

  

 Zocdoc is a mission\-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values \-
 *Together, Not Alone* 
 , we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

title: Intern

**We’re Looking For People Who**

* Deliver high quality work with consistency and pride
* Collaborate effectively and elevate those around them
* Focus on outcomes that drive impact and growth


**Job Description**
**Join Pitney Bowes as an Intern
   

  

 Location: Pune (Hybrid\- 3days/week in\-office)
   

  

 Role: Third Party(contractual)**
**About The Role**
 We are seeking enthusiastic and self\-driven engineers with strong fundamentals, curiosity and automation mindset in Network Operations, Automation, DevOps, and Infrastructure Monitoring.
   

  

 This role is focused on building a modern, automation\-first Network Operations Center (NOC) rather than a traditional helpdesk environment.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical skills, networking fundamentals, and an interest in scripting, observability, and automation technologies.
   

  

* Responsibilities DevOps (Modern NOC \- Automation \& Continuous Improvement)

* Work with monitoring and observability tools (e.g. Grafana)

* Develop basic scripts (Python / PowerShell) to reduce manual effort.
* Work with APIs and structured data formats (JSON)

* Familiarity with WAN, VPN, and Internet connectivity

**DevOps / Automation (Must\-Have)**

* Understanding of cloud fundamentals (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Basic working knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems
* Awareness of REST API, Webhook, CSV, Jason etc.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong communication and stakeholder coordination skills
* Ability to work in a 24x7 shift\-based NOC environment.
* Good documentation discipline and attention to detail.
* Ability to perform under pressure during incidents and outages.

title: Application Development & Support Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
 Position Overview
   

  

 The MDM Developer is a solid, independent contributor who builds and supports MDM platform features end\-to\-end. Owns features from development through production support under the “you build it, you support it” model. Works with moderate guidance from senior team members on complex design decisions but independently delivers sprint commitments and resolves production issues within their domain.
   

  

 Platform Development \& Enhancement
   

  

* Build and configure MDM platform features across assigned domains
* Implement match/merge/survivorship rules based on design specifications
* Build and maintain hierarchy structures and relationship configurations
* Build stewardship workflows and business rules per design specifications
* Implement region\-specific configurations including conditional attributes, validation rules, and approval routing per design specifications
* Build and maintain custom data entry screens and validation rules per design specifications
* Execute data mapping and onboarding for new sources per established patterns
* Execute data migrations and bulk operations per migration plans
* Implement platform enhancements and optimizations
* Participate in design discussions and raise technical concerns


 Platform Modernization
   

  

* Execute modernization tasks per established plans and timelines
* Implement data mapping per specifications during modernization phases
* Perform regression testing and report discrepancies during modernization


 Production Support, Troubleshooting \& Incident Resolution
   

  

* Own production support for features you built — resolve incidents within SLAs
* Resolve data issues within your domain; escalate cross\-system issues with root cause context
* Analyze application and database logs to identify issue root cause
* Identify patterns in recurring issues and propose permanent fixes
* Debug data flows within your domain to identify where failures occur
* Resolve defects in match/merge configuration and data processing logic
* Execute data reconciliation tasks and validate synchronization
* Collaborate with adjacent teams (data lake, ERP) when issues span system boundaries
* Share knowledge on resolved issues through documentation and team sessions


 Testing \& Quality
   

  

* Develop and execute test cases for SIT and UAT
* Perform system integration testing for assigned features
* Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback
* Refactor code to improve readability and performance
* Address technical debt in assigned areas
* Use CI/CD pipelines for deployments and troubleshoot pipeline failures
* Perform post\-production validation for your releases; execute rollback procedures per established plans
* Participate in DR testing and validate recovery procedures


 Security \& Compliance
   

  

* Working knowledge of data security, information security practices, and SOX compliance procedures


**Required Qualifications**
* 6\+ years hands\-on MDM platform experience (e.g., Informatica MDM, Reltio, SAP MDM, Semarchy, Profisee)
* 6\+ years advanced SQL experience — complex queries, joins, subqueries, data analysis (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL)
* 4\+ years hands\-on coding — write, debug, and refactor code (e.g., Java, Python, PL/SQL, shell scripting)
* 3\+ years experience with match/merge, survivorship, and stewardship workflows
* 3\+ years experience with data migrations and bulk operations
* 3\+ years experience with data mapping and integration tools (e.g., Informatica PowerCenter, IICS, Talend, MuleSoft)
* 3\+ years experience using CI/CD pipelines and troubleshooting failures (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps)
* 2\+ years experience with log analysis and monitoring tools (e.g., Splunk, ELK Stack, Datadog, CloudWatch)
* 2\+ years experience with incident management using ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira)
* Experience working across at least 2 MDM domains
* Strong knowledge of SDLC: requirements, development, testing (unit, SIT, UAT), CI/CD, change management, release management


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Multi\-domain MDM experience
* Manufacturing industry experience
* Informatica MDM or Reltio platform experience
* Familiarity with event\-driven architecture and APIs
* Awareness of AI/ML applications in MDM
* Familiarity with graph database concepts
* Familiarity with workflow orchestration
* Experience working with adjacent data teams
* Agile/Scrum delivery experience


**About The Team**

 No calls or agencies please. Vertiv will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F\-1, H\-1, H\-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

title: AVP - Oracle Fusion Support Lead
description:

 Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth.  Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M\&G is transforming as a business.

 Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
   

  

 Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long\-term investment and savings solutions.
   

  

 Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Oracle Fusion Lead to join our Corporate Finance Technology (CFT) team. This role is responsible for providing first\-line functional support for Oracle Fusion cloud ERP application, managing stakeholder expectations, and supervising a team of support analysts. The ideal candidate will possess strong domain knowledge, excellent problem\-solving skills, and the ability to lead and coordinate support operations effectively.
   

  

 As a Lead in Oracle Fusion Support, your responsibilities will include:
   

  

**Functional Support \& Issue Resolution**
* Provide expert\-level support across Oracle Finance Cloud modules: GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Expenses, Cash Management, Transaction Tax, Intercompany, and BPM Approvals.

* Analyse and resolve ServiceNow tickets, adhering to SLAs.

* Support version upgrades and lead service reviews with vendor.

* Support the end user training sessions on Oracle Fusion new processes and functions.
* Promote awareness of audit and compliance principles in daily operations of the team.
* Evaluate new requirements by coordinating with business stakeholders and manage and co\-ordinate the implementation lifecycle.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Act as a primary point of contact for business users regarding Oracle Fusion\-related queries and issues.
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand requirements, manage expectations, and provide timely updates on issue resolution.
* Participate in change management discussions and impact assessments for new business requirements.


**Team Leadership \& Supervision**
* Allocate and supervise work across team members, ensuring balanced workloads and timely resolution of support tickets.
* Mentor and guide junior analysts, fostering a collaborative and high\-performance team culture.
* Monitor team performance against SLAs and drive continuous improvement in support processes.


 This role offers a unique opportunity to lead a high\-performing support team, work on mission\-critical financial systems, and engage with stakeholders across the enterprise. If you are passionate about Oracle Fusion, enjoy solving complex functional challenges, and thrive in a leadership role, we invite you to be part of our transformation journey.

**Internal**
* UK Finance Accounting
* UK Finance Actuarial
* UK Corporate Functions technology


**External**
* Software Suppliers
* External Consultants


**Knowledge, Skills, Experience \& Educational Qualification**
**Required Knowledge \& Skills**
* Expertise in Oracle Fusion: In\-depth understanding of Oracle Fusion Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) and Record\-to\-Report (R2R) processes.
* ERP Experience: Minimum 12\+ years of hands\-on experience in Finance ERP application support, maintenance, or implementation.
* Configuration Proficiency: Strong practical knowledge of Oracle Fusion configurations.


**Preferred Knowledge \& Skills**
* Team Leadership: Proven experience in managing teams, including task allocation and performance supervision.
* Domain Exposure: Background in captive organizations within the banking, insurance, or financial services sectors.
* Innovation \& Technology: Exposure to AI enablement within Oracle Fusion modules.
* Stakeholder Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills for effective collaboration with cross\-functional stakeholders.


**Educational Qualifications**

* Postgraduate Qualification: Master’s degree in Finance or equivalent certifications.
* Professional Certifications:
+ Oracle certifications in P2P or R2R modules.
+ Additional credentials such as CBAP, PMP, or certifications in Business Transformation or Finance Functional domains are a plus.


 We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M\&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. description:

The role requires leadership in solution architecture, platform integration, architecture governance, and stakeholder engagement, with the ability to design and support integrated virtualized solutions aligned to business, security, and operational requirements.  1\.

* Manage KVM\-based virtualization platforms using tools such as libvirt and virsh.

* Install, configure, and troubleshoot enterprise Linux systems.

 3

* Analyze customer requirements and recommend suitable infrastructure architectures.
* Design compute, storage, network, and virtualization solutions.

 4\.

* Work with Fibre Channel (FC), iSCSI, and NFS storage technologies.

 5\.
 **Network Configuration and Troubleshooting** 



* Manage VLANs, network bonding, routing, and TCP/IP connectivity.
* Diagnose performance bottlenecks and network\-related issues.
* Collaborate with network and security teams.



 6\.
 **Customer Support and Problem Resolution** 



* Investigate complex technical issues.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA).
* Provide recommendations and long\-term fixes.
* Communicate solutions effectively to customers and stakeholders.



**Typical Day\-to\-Day Activities** 



* Reviewing infrastructure health and performance.
* Troubleshooting Linux, virtualization, storage, or network issues.
* Assisting customers with migrations and deployments.
* Conducting architecture reviews and solution discussions.
* Implementing security and availability best practices.
* Writing technical documentation and operational procedures.

description:
This role requires you to work in a shift pattern or non\-standard work hours as required. This may include weekend work.
   

  

 Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience troubleshooting and advocating for customer needs, and triaging technical issues (e.g., hardware, software, application, operational, process).
* Experience with one common scripting or coding language (e.g., Python, shell scripting).
* Systems experience (e.g., Linux, Unix) or a similar operating system.
* Experience in operating system kernel, file systems, and TCP/IP network protocols (e.g., DNS, routing, firewalls, and load balancing concepts).

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Software\-defined networking experience with public Cloud or SDN software.
* Familiarity with the HTTP protocol and APIs based on HTTP.
* Familiarity with network namespaces, how to take packet captures, and how to interpret packet captures.
* Knowledge of network specific kernel parameters (TCP keepalives, TCP windows, etc.).


**About the job** 
 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
   

  

 As a Technical Solutions Engineer, you will own large and important customer issues in addition to providing level two support to other support teams. You will be a part of a global team that provides 24x7 support to help customers seamlessly make the switch to Google Cloud.
   

  

 In this role, you will troubleshoot technical problems for customers with a mix of debugging, networking, system administration, updating documentation, and when needed, coding/scripting. You will make products easier to adopt and use by making improvements to the product, tools, processes and documentation. Your team is driven by customers and you will help drive the success of Google Cloud by understanding and advocating for customers’ issues.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage the customer’s problems through effective diagnosis, resolution, or implementation of new investigation tools to increase productivity for customer issues on Google Cloud Platform products.
* Develop knowledge of Google's product technology and underlying architectures by troubleshooting, reproducing, determining the root cause for customer reported issues.
* Work as part of a team of Engineers/Consultants that globally ensure 24 hour customer support, including a need to sometimes work non\-standard work hours or shifts.
* Act as a consultant and subject matter expert for internal stakeholders in Engineering, Sales, and customer organizations to resolve technical deployment obstacles and improve Google Cloud.
* Improve the supportability of Google Cloud networking technologies by working with product engineering teams on product launches and helping product teams understand customer issues to improve existing products.
